title: Commitment runway sprint lab — QBR tracker & playbook (working)
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, tactical spreadsheet to run a 2-week sprint focused on recovering at-risk subscription commitments and converting renewal conversations into firm motions. It combines a canonical tracker (contract dates, ARR, probability) with a living playbook column so CS reps can pick and execute the right sequence without context switching.

How to use (quick):
- Sort by Time-to-Renew (weeks) then by probability ascending.
- Focus on red (>=$50k ARR & <40% probability) first — escalate / exec motion.
- For green deals (<20% risk), ensure closed-loop on legal and billing 2 weeks pre-expiry.
- Update row after every customer touch; use the last_touch column to drive cadence.

Columns (sheet layout - header row):
Account | Account ID | ARR (USD) | Contract End | Time-to-Renew (wks) | Stage | Renewal Probability (%) | Prob Reasoning | Next Step (ownerable) | Owner | Last Touch (YYYY-MM-DD) | Risk Notes | Recommended Play | Exec Sponsor | Escalation Level | Upsell Opportunity | Confidence (RAG)

Sample rows (working examples):
Acme Analytics | ACC-001234 | 240000 | 2027-10-08 | 2 | Contract Review | 28 | Price sensitivity + legal open items | Legal kickoff + 1:1 with VP Product (Tom) | Tom Chen | 2027-09-21 | PO delay, procurement change | Execute "AMNESTY" discount (max 7%) + 2wk legal SLA | VP Sales intro | High | 30k (integration) | RED
BlueFin Retail | ACC-004321 | 90000 | 2027-11-01 | 5 | Negotiation | 55 | Healthy usage but competing bid | Product health check + demo refresh (Priya) | Priya Kumar | 2027-09-25 | Competing RFP | Offer 6mo pilot of Redwood Optimize + case study commitment | CSM director check-in | Medium | 15k | AMBER
Cedar Biologics | ACC-007777 | 60000 | 2028-01-12 | 16 | At-Risk | 18 | Security audit concerns (private deployment) | Schedule infra review + KMS checklist + SOW rework | Jordan Blake | 2027-09-10 | Compliance blockers | Private deployment pilot + custom SOW + security letter | Eng-hosted escalation | High | 0 | RED
Delta Apps (low-touch) | ACC-009000 | 12000 | 2027-12-05 | 9 | Auto-renew candidate | 87 | Auto-renew enrolled, low-touch | Confirm billing window + invoice pre-send | Ops | 2027-09-20 | None | Auto-renew reminder 30/14/7 days | N/A | Low | 2k | GREEN

Probability heuristics (suggested):
- Base probability: 80% for accounts with on-platform usage > 60% of seat capacity and N days since last outage < 14.
- Subtract 20% for active procurement/legal threads unresolved > 14 days.
- Subtract additional 25% if competitive RFP confirmed.
- Add 10% for exec sponsorship or closed engineering POC.
(We store the heuristic as notes; each rep should record "Prob Reasoning" textually.)

Automated fields (notes for spreadsheet formulas):
- Time-to-Renew (wks): =INT((Contract_End - TODAY())/7)
- Confidence (RAG): IF(Renewal_Probability>=75,"GREEN",IF(Renewal_Probability>=40,"AMBER","RED"))
- ARR buckets for prioritization: >150k = Tier A; 50-150k = Tier B; <50k = Tier C

Playbook (short snippets to paste into the next_step field):
- Exec intro + usage dashboard: request 30-min exec sync, share 2 slides of usage + cost savings. (Use TEMPLATE: exec-sync-brief v2)
- Legal sprint: assign legal owner, send redlines matrix, set 5-business-day SLA for counter-sign.
- Product ROI refresh: 1:1 demo of new throughput and cost curves; tie to customer's feature ask.
- Technical health check (for private/dedicated): infra checkpoint, SRE runbook review, provide test account for audit.
- Winback discount: capped % by ARR bucket and require case study or 12-month commit.

Escalation matrix (quick):
- Level 1: CSM + CSM manager — for Tier C/B where probability <40%.
- Level 2: CS Director + Solutions Eng — for Tier B (>=50k) with prob <30%.
- Level 3: GM + Sales + Engineering leadership — for Tier A (>150k) with prob <50% or legal SLA missed.

Open action items & TODOs:
- [ ] Add column for "Billing hold reason" (finance requested) — Jordan actioning (due 2027-09-30).
- [ ] Attach QBR slides link per account (quick link) — make a new column if we want.
- [ ] Build view for Dedicated/Private customers to include security dependencies.
- [ ] Ask Product for an "expiry impact" glance: list of features at risk if a customer churns (needed for exec asks).

Notes / context / links:
- See playbook snippets in Confluence: CONFLUENCE-REDWOOD-2098 (playbook templates and email copy).
- Related JIRA: JIRA-CS-5832 for the legal SLA pilot.
- Slack thread: #cs-renewal-ops (link above) for daily stand notes.

Rep checklist before next sprint sync:
1) Update probability and last_touch for all rows due within 6 weeks.
2) Ensure at least one recommended play is populated for RED rows.
3) For all Tier A red rows, book an escalation review 72 hours after initial outreach.

Quick retrospective metrics to track (sheet tab idea):
- Weekly conversion delta (probability movement) by owner.
- Time-to-contract after first legal send (median days).
- % deals moved from RED to AMBER/GREEN within 14 days.

Notes to self (Elena):
- Keep sheet simple; reps hate too many tabs. Start with one master sheet + a "playbook snippets" tab.
- We will iterate the probability heuristic after two sprints based on observed conversion.

End of working tracker — use this sheet as the single source for the sprint, then snapshot into the renewal report deck for QBRs and exec reviews.
